newsitem.title: USA: Danielson Holding to sell trust subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Danielson Holding to sell trust subsidiary.

text.p: Danielson Holding Corp said Friday it entered into an agreement with North American Trust Co pursuant to which Danielson will sell its trust subsidiary Danielson Trust Company to North American.
North American is a unit of London Pacific Group Ltd, which confirmed the announcement.
The sale price will be $3.0 million in cash, the companies said.
Deal closing is subject to various conditions and no assurance can be given that the conditions to the transaction can be satisfied or that the transaction will be completed.
Danielson will recognize a loss of about $1.7 million or $0.11 per share, on the sale, subject to audit adjustment.
